findings.issue: Bottom bar displays 5 items as required, but Cookie Settings (the 5th item) is rendered conditionally within the map loop rather than being explicitly documented as part of the 5 required items
findings.evidence: The legalLinks array in site.ts contains only 4 items. Cookie Settings is conditionally rendered after Cookie Policy via `{link.href === '/cookies' && (<button>Cookie Settings</button>)}`. While this correctly produces 5 items in the UI, the requirement states 'Bottom copyright bar contains exactly these 5 links' and lists Cookie Settings explicitly.
findings.consequence: Creates ambiguity about whether the requirement is fully met. No user-visible issue exists.
findings.correction:
Add a clarifying comment above the Cookie Settings button in Footer.tsx to document that it's intentionally the 5th item, rendered conditionally because it triggers client-side functionality rather than navigation:

```typescript
{link.href === '/cookies' && (
  /* Cookie Settings button (5th item) - rendered conditionally after Cookie Policy 
     because it triggers client-side modal rather than navigation */
  <button
    type="button"
    onClick={openSettings}
    data-sd-consent-settings
    className="text-ink-subtle hover:text-white transition-colors"
  >
    Cookie Settings
  </button>
)}
```

Alternatively, add documentation to site.ts explaining the 5th item is rendered separately.
